title: Blasting Production Rate (Approximate)
applicability: Typical rates for 8mm (5/16") nozzle at 690 kPa (100 psi): SP 5 white metal: 10–15 m²/hr. SP 10 near-white: 15–25 m²/hr. SP 6 commercial: 25–40 m²/hr. Rates vary significantly with rust grade, coating thickness, and operator skill.

title: Abrasive Consumption (Expendable)
equation: Consumption (kg/m²) ≈ 25–50 for SP 10 (field blasting with mineral abrasive)
applicability: Varies with initial condition, nozzle size, pressure, and abrasive type. Garnet: lower consumption (harder, less breakdown). Coal slag: higher consumption. Recyclable metallic: consumption is makeup rate only.

title: Compressed Air Volume Requirement
applicability: Rule of thumb: 6mm nozzle ≈ 4.2 m³/min (150 cfm); 8mm ≈ 7.1 m³/min (250 cfm); 10mm ≈ 11.3 m³/min (400 cfm); 12mm ≈ 15.6 m³/min (550 cfm). Size compressor accordingly with 50% margin for line losses.

title: Soluble Salt Extraction Concentration
applicability: Bresle method: 2.5 mL distilled water in 12.5 cm² patch. Conductivity in μS/cm. Use calibration curve for NaCl equivalence. Some field kits give direct μg/cm² reading.
